brief_for_model.goal: Diagnose why this story Boiler adaptation keeps failing while Speckled Band completed cleanly.
known_ops_noise: Laravel Cloud deploys killed workers mid-Finalize (attempts inflated → MaxAttemptsExceeded).
Tinker finally-closures orphaned Bus batches (batch pending jobs with empty jobs table).
Release reserved jobs MUST reset attempts to 0.
Do not treat MaxAttemptsExceeded as a content bug.
known_content_failures_seen: Finalize: invalid word or turn budgets on scene cards.
Editorial: choice_ids vs Phase 5 authority; weak playable rooms; SESSION_END_HOOK binding.
Draft: duplicate source_event_ids across moments; target_moment_count outside SSM range.
brief_for_model.ask: Separate ops/retry damage from true prompt/validator defects. Propose the smallest durable code/prompt fixes.
